entries.plain: Adds 2 inches to the standard comfort-selector handle for better leverage.
entries.pitch: “This longer handle gives you more leverage, so raising and lowering the legrest takes less effort.”

entries.plain: Adds a Contour Cushion foam layer over a high-resiliency foam base for the seat and legrest. The special foam has millions of air capsules that mold to the body for a soothing hug on the back and hips. Raises the foam warranty from 1 year to 3 years.
entries.pitch: “The Contour Cushion molds to your body and relieves pressure points, and it carries a longer foam warranty.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Upgrades the Comfort Core seat cushion to ComfortCore Plus with Contour Cushion, a temperature-resistant foam that contours to the body. Raises the foam warranty from 3 years to 5 years.
entries.pitch: “This is the most personal seat we make: it contours to you and carries a 5-year foam warranty.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Upgrades accent pillows to 95% duck feathers and 5% duck down in a down-proof ticking fabric. Raises the foam warranty from 3 years to 5 years on styles where that applies.
entries.pitch: “Featherlite pillows feel plush and hold a softer, more relaxed shape.”
entries.caution: Accent pillows are not available on covers with cap codes LL, LS, LM, RL, BU, UE (April 2026 Fabric & Leather List).
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Changes the cover on the accent pillows. Enter the code followed by the contrasting fabric number.
entries.pitch: “Contrasting pillows let you add colour or pattern without changing the whole piece.”
entries.caution: Accent pillows are not available on covers with cap codes LL, LS, LM, RL, BU, UE (April 2026 Fabric & Leather List).
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Changes the cover on the accent pillows. Enter the code followed by the contrasting fabric number.

entries.plain: 360-degree, full-race ball-bearing circular base. Available on select styles. Not available on wall recliners or the Summit Series.
entries.pitch: “A swivel base lets you turn toward the TV, the window or the conversation without getting up.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: 145-degree turn with stoppers for safety on a ball-bearing circular base. Adds 1 inch to overall height. Not available on wall recliners or the Summit Series.
entries.pitch: “It turns part of the way for conversation or the TV, and the stoppers keep it safe.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Moves the mounted controls from right to left side sitting.
entries.pitch: “The controls move to the left side, where you sit.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Switches to a left-side sitting mounted cradle with the wireless remote. The cradle includes a remote finder.
entries.pitch: “The remote cradle moves to the left side, with a remote finder in the cradle.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Replaces the side control panel with a corded hand wand. The cord runs through the centre so either hand can use it. No USB charging with the hand wand.
entries.pitch: “A simple corded hand wand is easy to hold and works with either hand.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Replaces the outside toggle controls with two sitting-mounted cradles with wireless remotes. Remote finder in the cradle, both memory settings on the remote and the cradle.
entries.pitch: “Two seats means two remotes, each with its own memory settings.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Both sitting positions get a control panel.
entries.pitch: “Each side of the sofa has its own controls.”
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Fabric pattern pieces are cut parallel to the selvage, so no pattern match is possible. On sofas, sleep sofas and multi-seat modular units the front rail is vertically seamed and may not match.

entries.plain: Pattern pieces are cut perpendicular to the selvage (railroaded). No vertical pattern match is possible; a horizontal match depends on the fabric design.

entries.plain: Railroaded and matched vertically only. Seat cushions are reversible on mirrored-image designs.

entries.plain: Pattern pieces are cut parallel to the selvage and locked on the stripe line, so the stripe flows horizontally across inside backs, inside arms, seats and rails.

entries.plain: Needs 10–12 in from the wall to recline. Weight tested to 300 lb. Key features: Press-back reclining; Wingnut back-tension adjustment; No-sag springs.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues), issued 2025-11

entries.plain: Needs 0–0 in from the wall to recline. Key features: Fully padded interlocking frame; Ottoman features.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues), issued 2026-06

entries.plain: Tall base included. Deep seat and taller back. Weight tested to 300 lb. Available in 010, 10U, 10X, 016 and 16X.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: Elongated handle and tall base included. Wider-scale frame, taller back, extra seat and back springs, bolstered rocker blocks and springs, extra-deep seat with full chaise legrest. No swivel bases allowed. Weight tested to 300 lb. Available in 010, 10U, 10X, 016 and 16X.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)

entries.plain: The ordering code for one item: style code, then cover, then any finish and options, for example 10X709 B153853. The app builds and decodes these strings so you can copy them into RMS.
entries.pitch: Always confirm the line in RMS before promising it; the app does not check orders.
entries.source: Point of Sale Basics RMS 101 (option codes page); project SKU grammar

entries.plain: The point-of-sale screen where orders are entered. The app mirrors its fields (Group, Style, Grade, Pattern, Color) so a code from the app can be keyed in directly.
entries.source: Point of Sale Basics RMS 101 (FY23)
entries.caution: What the letters stand for is not in the supplied data.

entries.plain: The first characters of a style code. They tell you what mechanism or construction it is. 10X is a power rocking recliner with headrest and lumbar; 016 is a wall recliner; 44 is a La-Z-Time motion sofa.
entries.pitch: Learn the prefix families first. They sort the whole catalog.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library June 2026, table of contents; April 2026 Product Information Guide

entries.plain: The three-digit number and name that give a family its look: 709 Jasper, 724 Trouper. One model comes in several styles (prefixes), so the same look can be a rocker, a wall recliner or a power chair.
entries.pitch: Pick the look with the customer first, then the prefix for how it moves.
entries.source: April 2026 Product Information Guide

entries.plain: The letter at the start of a cover code: B1538 is grade B. The price book lists fabric prices in grade groups (B–C, D–F, G–N, P–Q), so a higher grade group costs more. The app shows no prices; read the figure from the price book.
entries.pitch: Quote the price from the price book, never from memory.
entries.source: April 2026 Upholstery Price Book (price list columns); April 2026 Fabric & Leather List

entries.plain: The four digits after the grade letter that identify one fabric or leather design, for example 1538 Seamount.
entries.source: April 2026 Fabric & Leather List

entries.plain: The two digits that pick the colour of a pattern, for example 53 Silver. Each pattern lists its own colours.
entries.source: April 2026 Fabric & Leather List

entries.plain: The fabric or leather on the body of the furniture: grade, pattern and colour together, for example B153853.
entries.source: April 2026 Fabric & Leather List

entries.plain: Some styles list specific covers as Select fabric, Select faux leather or Select leather in the price book. These are named per style, so check the exact style’s list.
entries.pitch: If the customer loves a cover that is not on the style’s select list, check the other cover groups before saying no.
entries.source: April 2026 Upholstery Price Book (style headers)

entries.plain: The guide’s section for sofas, loveseats and modular sectionals with reclining seats: Reclina-Way, La-Z-Time and La-Z-Motion families.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library June 2026, table of contents

entries.plain: The rocking recliner family: 010, power P10, 10U and 10X. Rocks as well as reclines.
entries.source: April 2026 Product Information Guide (base kit notes); Product Knowledge Library June 2026

entries.plain: The wall recliner family: 016, power P16 and 16X. Designed to sit close to a wall; see the wall-space figure on the style.
entries.pitch: Ask how far the chair sits from the wall before choosing between rocker and wall recliner.
entries.source: April 2026 Product Information Guide (base kit notes); Product Knowledge Library June 2026

entries.plain: Motion family with prefixes 44_ (manual), U4_ (power with headrest) and X4_ (power with headrest and lumbar).
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library June 2026, table of contents

entries.plain: A reclining sofa, loveseat or chair family with prefixes P9_. The Duo battery pack (0881YC) is for styles with two power recliners.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library June 2026; April 2026 Product Information Guide (battery pack)

entries.plain: Power lift chairs: Bronze (3BL), Gold (1HM) and Platinum (1PL, 1PH). Each has its own weight rating; use the lift-chair weight tiers under Support.
entries.pitch: Always match the tested weight to the person, and never relax it.
entries.source: Product Knowledge Library June 2026, table of contents

entries.plain: The top lift series. Adjustable power-tilt headrest from 0 to 55 degrees, power lumbar with nearly 3.5 in of additional support, a pivoting lumbar pad and a spring-action headrest return that prevents pinching.
entries.pitch: Sell the headrest and lumbar: the customer sets their own head and neck position and back support with a button.
entries.source: Platinum-Lifts Features and Benefits, Rev 01

entries.plain: Sleep sofas come with the Supreme Comfort mattress (5.5 in innerspring with quilted damask topper, 5-year warranty) as standard. Upgrade to a Slumberaire air mattress (5-year) or a Tempur-Response memory foam mattress (3-year).
entries.pitch: Ask how often guests actually sleep over: that decides standard versus upgrade.
entries.source: Product Knowledge One Pagers (mattress page)

entries.plain: The standard Premier stationary seat construction: zoned cushioning with a 36 lb and a 27 lb polyurethane centre.
entries.source: April 2026 Upholstery Price Book, seat constructions (p. 17–19)

entries.plain: A softer recliner seat made by adding an extra layer of 12 lb polyurethane foam on top of the polyurethane foam core.
entries.pitch: For the customer who says “soft”.
entries.source: April 2026 Upholstery Price Book, seat constructions

entries.plain: Five seat springs and a 36 lb foam core for optimal support.
entries.source: April 2026 Upholstery Price Book, seat constructions

entries.plain: A seat topper of temperature-resistant 2.5-density foam that moulds to the body over a 2.5-density 36 lb core. On recliners it runs from the seat through the legrest. 3-year cushion warranty.
entries.pitch: Sell it as the cushion that hugs sore backs and hips.
entries.source: Gliding Recliner Resource Guide 017; Product Knowledge One Pagers

entries.plain: A plump, feathery blend over resilient foam around an individually pocketed coil core. Raises the foam warranty from 3 to 5 years.
entries.pitch: The cloud-soft option.
entries.source: Product Knowledge One Pagers

entries.plain: Seat type printed as “Premier standard (SS)” on stationary styles. The seat construction definitions are on pages 17–19 of the price book.
entries.source: April 2026 Product Information Guide; April 2026 Upholstery Price Book
entries.caution: The “(SS)” tag itself is not defined in the supplied data.

entries.plain: Limited lifetime on parts for springs, mechanism and frame, with 1 year on labour. 3-year warranty on a ComfortCore seat cushion. 1 year on all other foam, fabric and leather. Categories differ; see Support for the matrix.
entries.pitch: State the warranty from the guide only. Never add promises.
entries.source: Product Knowledge One Pagers; mechanism guide warranty tiers

entries.plain: The collection sheet for a sectional that shows which pieces can connect. The app says to check every layout against it before ordering.
entries.pitch: A layout in the app is a planning aid. The tear pad decides what can be ordered.
entries.source: Sectional tear-pad profiles bundled with the app
entries.caution: The tear pad sheets themselves are not in the supplied project files.

entries.plain: Manual rockers swivel 360 degrees; power rockers swivel 145 degrees. A tall base adds 1 to 1.5 in to seat height and overall height depending on the kit. Base kits are separate RMS lines.
entries.pitch: Ask about knees and getting up: a tall base helps taller customers.
entries.source: April 2026 Product Information Guide (base assembly kits)

entries.plain: A rechargeable pack that replaces the corded power supply on power styles. Check compatibility for the exact style under Support before adding one.
entries.source: April 2026 Product Information Guide (batteries)

entries.plain: Pillows that come with some styles. FeatherLite upgrades them to 95% duck feather and 5% duck down in a cotton down-proof ticking. Contrasting pillows (P1/P2) let the pillow fabric differ from the body cover. Not available on LL, LS, LM, RL, BU or UE covers.
entries.pitch: Pillows are an easy add-on that changes the look. Check the cover’s cap code first.
entries.source: Product Knowledge One Pagers; April 2026 Fabric & Leather List
